ResourceHeader.Description:
This list of interplanetary sector boundary crossings has been compiled by Leif Svalgaard from ground magnetometer data and in situ interplanetary magnetic field observations Identification of the boundaries .  For each crossing, the day of crossing, the direction of 
crossing (+to- or -to+) and the durations (in whole days) of single-polarity intervals on either side of the crossing are given.
